question: Become less intense or widespread
explanation: Abate is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: कम होना, घटना. Example: “The storm began to abate by evening.”

question: A place where animals are slaughtered for consumption as food
explanation: Abattoir is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: कसाईखाना. Example: “The animals were taken to the abattoir.”

question: The superior of a monastery
explanation: Abbot is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: मठ का प्रमुख. Example: “The abbot supervised the monastery.”

question: To reduce to a shorter form intended to stand for the whole
explanation: Abbreviation is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: संक्षिप्त रूप. Example: ““Dr.” is an abbreviation of “Doctor.””

question: To give up one's authority or throne
explanation: Abdicate is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: अपना पद या दावा छोड़ देना. Example: “The king decided to abdicate the throne.”

question: Act of giving up (renouncing) the throne
explanation: Abdication is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: अपने अधिकार अथवा पद का त्याग करना. Example: “The king's abdication changed the line of succession.”

question: Deviation from the right course
explanation: Aberration is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: असामान्यता, अपवर्तन. Example: “His rude remark was an aberration from his usual behaviour.”

question: The act of washing oneself
explanation: Ablution is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: हाथ या शरीर को धोना/शुद्ध करना. Example: “The ritual requires ablution before prayer.”

question: To refuse or deny oneself
explanation: Abnegate is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: त्यागना. Example: “She chose to abnegate her own interests for the team.”

question: Formally put an end to a system, practice, or institution
explanation: Abolish is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: किसी रिवाज या स्थापित नियम का अंत करना. Example: “The government decided to abolish the outdated rule.”

question: Existing in a land from the earliest times or from before the arrival of colonists
explanation: Aboriginal is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: किसी देश के मूल निवासी. Example: “The museum displays Aboriginal art.”

question: The original inhabitants/natives of a country
explanation: Aborigines is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: किसी देश के मूल निवासी. Example: “The history book discusses the Aborigines of the region.”

question: To shorten a piece of writing without losing the sense
explanation: Abridge is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: छोटा कर देना. Example: “The editor had to abridge the report.”

question: A shortened version of a larger work
explanation: Abridgement is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: संक्षिप्त संस्करण. Example: “This is an abridgement of the original novel.”

question: Cancel or do away with (a law or agreement)
explanation: Abrogate is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: निरस्त या रद्द कर देना. Example: “The court cannot simply abrogate a valid agreement.”

question: To go away suddenly and secretly in order to escape from somewhere
explanation: Abscond is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: फरार होना. Example: “The suspect tried to abscond before the police arrived.”

question: Formal forgiveness of a person's sins
explanation: Absolution is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: पापमुक्ति, क्षमादान. Example: “The priest offered absolution after the confession.”

question: Wildly unreasonable, illogical or ridiculous
explanation: Absurd is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: बेतुका. Example: “It would be absurd to ignore clear evidence.”

question: To increase the speed
explanation: Accelerate is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: गति बढ़ाना. Example: “The car began to accelerate after the signal.”

question: Any award, honour or laudatory notice
explanation: Accolade is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: पुरस्कार/सम्मान. Example: “The scientist received an accolade for her research.”

question: A person who helps another to commit a crime or to do something morally wrong // A partner in crime
explanation: Accomplice is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: सह-अपराधी. Example: “The police arrested the thief and his accomplice.”

question: Be harmonious or consistent with
explanation: Accord is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: अनुरूप होना. Example: “The policy is in accord with the existing rules.”

question: A person whose profession is to keep accounts
explanation: Accountant is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: मुनीम/लेखापाल. Example: “The accountant prepared the annual accounts.”

question: Sharp, bitter, or harsh in temper, language, etc.
explanation: Acerbic is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: कड़वा स्वभाव. Example: “His acerbic comments offended the audience.”

question: The scientific study of sound
explanation: Acoustics is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: ध्वनि-विज्ञान. Example: “The hall has excellent acoustics.”

question: To decide and state officially in court that somebody is not guilty of a crime
explanation: Acquit is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: बरी/दोषमुक्त कर देना. Example: “The court decided to acquit the accused.”

question: An entertainer who performs difficult physical feats
explanation: Acrobat is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: हवाई करतब करने वाला. Example: “The acrobat performed a difficult routine.”

question: An abbreviation formed from the initial letters of other words and pronounced as a word
explanation: Acronym is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: शब्दों के पहले अक्षरों से बना शब्द. Example: “NASA is an acronym.”

question: Fear of great heights
explanation: Acrophobia is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: ऊंचाई का डर. Example: “Her acrophobia prevents her from going near tall edges.”

question: To do something // to behave in a particular way // to perform a part in a play/film/function
explanation: Act is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: कार्य करना, अभिनय करना. Example: “He acted confidently during the interview.”

question: Giving cause for legal action
explanation: Actionable is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: कानूनी कार्यवाही करने योग्य. Example: “The report contained actionable information.”

question: Make a machine active or operative
explanation: Activate is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: सक्रिय करना. Example: “Press the button to activate the machine.”

question: The ability to make good judgments and take quick decisions // Sharpness and accuracy of judgement
explanation: Acumen is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: कुशाग्र बुद्धि. Example: “Her business acumen helped the company.”

question: A person who is physically dependent on a substance/harmful drugs
explanation: Addict is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: नशेड़ी. Example: “The rehabilitation centre helped the drug addict.”

question: Believe in and follow the practices of
explanation: Adhere is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: पालन करना. Example: “Employees must adhere to the safety rules.”

question: The period between the beginning of puberty and adulthood
explanation: Adolescence is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: किशोरावस्था. Example: “During adolescence, many physical changes occur.”

question: An extremely beautiful young man
explanation: Adonis is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: खूबसूरत नौजवान. Example: “The hero is described as an Adonis.”

question: Very attractive and easy to feel love for
explanation: Adorable is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: प्यारा. Example: “The puppy was adorable.”

question: Make impure by adding inferior substances
explanation: Adulterate is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: मिलावट करना. Example: “Some traders adulterate milk with cheaper substances.”

question: Willing to take risks and try new ideas
explanation: Adventurous is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: साहसिक. Example: “The adventurous traveller explored remote villages.”

question: A person who supports or speaks in favour of something
explanation: Advocate is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: वकील/अधिवक्ता. Example: “She is an advocate of equal education.”

question: Growing/existing/living in air
explanation: Aerial is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: हवाई. Example: “The photographer took an aerial view.”

question: Concerned with beauty or the appreciation of beauty
explanation: Aesthetic is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: सौंदर्य सम्बन्धी. Example: “The designer considered the building's aesthetic appeal.”

question: A list of items to be discussed at a meeting
explanation: Agenda is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: कार्यसूची. Example: “The first item on the agenda was the budget.”

question: To increase the importance, position or wealth
explanation: Aggrandize is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: वृद्धि करना. Example: “He used the award to aggrandize his image.”

question: Always ready to attack or quarrel // One who is hostile and violent
explanation: Aggressive is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: आक्रामक. Example: “The aggressive driver nearly caused an accident.”

question: One who is not sure about God's existence
explanation: Agnostic is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: ईश्वर के बारे में संशयवादी व्यक्ति. Example: “He describes himself as agnostic.”

question: Extreme mental or physical suffering
explanation: Agony is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: कष्ट. Example: “The injured player was in agony.”

question: A blank book for keeping a collection of photographs, stamps or pictures
explanation: Album is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: चित्र संग्रह की किताब. Example: “She keeps old photographs in an album.”

question: Study of chemistry in a medieval fashion
explanation: Alchemy is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: मध्यकालीन रसायन विद्या. Example: “Alchemy was studied in medieval times.”

question: A substance for killing algae
explanation: Algaecide is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: शैवालनाशक. Example: “The pond was treated with an algaecide.”

question: Fear of pain
explanation: Algophobia is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: शरीर में कष्ट होने का डर. Example: “His algophobia makes medical procedures frightening.”

question: A person belonging to a foreign country // different from what you are used to // A fictional being from another world
explanation: Alien is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: अजनबी, विदेशी, अन्य ग्रह का प्राणी. Example: “The story features an alien from another world.”

question: The money paid to former wife, husband or partner when the marriage is ended
explanation: Alimony is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: छोड़े हुए साथी के लिए गुजारा भत्ता. Example: “The court ordered monthly alimony.”

question: A story, play, picture, etc. in which each character/event is a symbol representing an idea/a quality, such as truth, evil, death, etc.
explanation: Allegory is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: नीति कथा. Example: “The story is an allegory about good and evil.”

question: Words that begin with the same letter, syllable or sound // Repetition of an initial sound in two or more words of a line
explanation: Alliteration is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: अनुप्रास अलंकार. Example: ““Peter Piper picked” is an example of alliteration.”

question: Soil deposited by flowing water
explanation: Alluvium is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: पानी के बहाव द्वारा बिछाई गई मिट्टी. Example: “The river deposited fertile alluvium.”

question: The school or college in which one has been educated
explanation: Alma Mater is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: जहाँ शिक्षा पाई वह संस्था. Example: “She returned to her alma mater.”

question: A publication containing an astronomical or meteorological annual calendar that contains important dates and time
explanation: Almanac is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: पंचांग. Example: “The farmer consulted the almanac.”

question: Mountain climbing
explanation: Alpinism is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: पर्वतारोहण. Example: “Alpinism requires mountain skills.”

question: A table or flat surface where offerings are made to a deity
explanation: Altar is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: वह स्थान जहाँ भगवान पर चढ़ाने वाली सामग्री रखी जाती है. Example: “Flowers were placed on the altar.”

question: Instrument that measures the altitude of the land surface
explanation: Altimeter is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: ऊंचाई नापने का यंत्र. Example: “The pilot checked the altimeter.”

question: The height above sea level
explanation: Altitude is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: ऊंचाई. Example: “The city is at a high altitude.”

question: Someone who makes charitable donations intended to the welfare of other people
explanation: Altruist is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: परोपकारी. Example: “The altruist donated money to charity.”

question: A former student of a school, college or university
explanation: Alumnus is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: भूतपूर्व छात्र. Example: “He is an alumnus of the university.”

question: One who plays for pleasure rather than as a profession // A person who is neither well experienced nor professional // A non-professional who is inept at a particular activity
explanation: Amateur is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: शौकीन व्यक्ति/अनुभवहीन. Example: “He is an amateur photographer.”

question: Fear of riding in a car
explanation: Amaxophobia is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: वाहनों का डर. Example: “Her amaxophobia makes car travel frightening.”

question: A diplomatic representative in another country
explanation: Ambassador is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: राजदूत. Example: “The ambassador represented his country.”

question: Able to use the left hand and right hand equally well
explanation: Ambidextrous is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: उभयहस्त. Example: “The ambidextrous player can use either hand equally well.”

question: The character and atmosphere of a place
explanation: Ambience is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: वातावरण, माहौल. Example: “The restaurant has a pleasant ambience.”

question: Capable of being understood in either of two or more possible senses, and therefore not definite
explanation: Ambiguous is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: संदिग्धार्थी/अस्पष्ट. Example: “The wording was ambiguous and had two possible meanings.”
